caption:
Thomas Frank earns first Crystal Palace win over Real Sociedad

Thomas Frank has his first Crystal Palace win, over Real Sociedad, with Dwight McNeil named in the report's headline. Palace trailed to a Mamadou Sarr goal until Jon Martín was sent off 17 minutes from full time for denying Jean-Philippe Mateta an equaliser. Mateta scored the penalty.

Reported by The Guardian; Sky Sports.
